fictional_data_notice: SYNTHETIC TRAINING DATA. HarborPay Demo and all service descriptions, evidence notes, people, control states, and remediation records in this case are fictional. These materials are not audit reports, certificates, attestation, or proof of a real vendor's security.

assessment_scope.business_context: Payroll is operationally important and processes sensitive employee information.
assessment_scope.criticality: High (proposed lab tier; reviewer to confirm)
assessment_scope.review_objective: Determine whether the supplied fictional evidence supports onboarding, conditional onboarding, or a hold pending review.

evidence.label: Fictional ISO/IEC 27001 certificate metadata
evidence.content_notice: Synthetic metadata only. No certificate image, issuer, accreditation claim, signature, or real attestation is represented.
evidence.review_note: The stated date is before the assessment date. Treat this as a gap in current assurance evidence. It does not by itself show that a security control failed or that an incident occurred. Ask for current evidence and verify its issuer, entity, scope, and validity before relying on it.

evidence.label: Fictional SOC 2-style summary - version 1

evidence.exceptions: Not represented in this short synthetic summary
evidence.cuecs: Not represented in this short synthetic summary
evidence.content_notice: Illustrative training summary only. It is not issued by an auditor and cannot substantiate a SOC 2 examination.
evidence.review_note: The stated service boundary excludes the payroll service being assessed. A date range that appears recent cannot correct a service-scope mismatch.
evidence.initial_status: Out of scope for the assessed service

evidence.label: Fictional customer responsibility note - version 1
evidence.requirement: Require multi-factor authentication for privileged payroll administrator accounts before the service is used with employee data.
evidence.mock_state: Disabled in the fictional lab configuration
evidence.content_notice: Training requirement and mock state only; no actual employer or payroll system was inspected.
evidence.review_note: The customer is responsible for implementing this condition in the fictional scenario. Do not attribute this gap to HarborPay's controls.

evidence.label: Fictional access policy summary - control check fixture
evidence.content_notice: Synthetic summary prepared as a clean test fixture; not a real approved vendor policy.
evidence.review_note: This fixture should pass only the lab's documented presence, approval-date, and scope checks. It is not evidence that access reviews were performed effectively.

evidence.exceptions: Not represented in this short synthetic summary
evidence.cuecs: Not represented in this short synthetic summary

evidence.review_note: For the lab retest, this version corrects the declared service-boundary field. Reviewer must keep assurance status provisional because authenticity, actual report wording, exceptions, and other report content are not available.

evidence.label: Fictional MFA configuration screenshot description - version 2
evidence.requirement: Require multi-factor authentication for privileged payroll administrator accounts before the service is used with employee data.

evidence.content_notice: Mock configuration description only. No real system or screenshot was captured.

treatment_catalog.title: Current in-scope ISO assurance evidence unavailable
treatment_catalog.description: The fictional certificate metadata shows an expiry before the assessment date and has not been authenticated.
treatment_catalog.default_severity: Unrated; reviewer to determine using business context
treatment_catalog.required_action: Obtain and authenticate current evidence, verify the entity and payroll scope, and record a reviewer decision.
treatment_catalog.treatment_note: An expired date is not proof of a control failure or breach. Do not close this item with an unverified replacement or change of date.

treatment_catalog.title: Assurance summary does not initially cover payroll processing
treatment_catalog.description: Initial synthetic summary excludes the specific service under review.
treatment_catalog.default_severity: Unrated; reviewer to determine using business context
treatment_catalog.required_action: Obtain an authentic report covering the purchased service and document the reviewer’s scope analysis.
treatment_catalog.treatment_note: The synthetic v2 field tests the scope-check workflow. It does not replace the missing genuine report.

treatment_catalog.title: Customer-side MFA requirement unmet in the initial lab state
treatment_catalog.description: The fictional responsibility note assigns privileged payroll administrator MFA to the customer; its initial mock state is disabled.
treatment_catalog.default_severity: Unrated; reviewer to determine using business context
treatment_catalog.required_action: Before real use, the customer IAM owner should enable and verify MFA for all in-scope privileged accounts.
treatment_catalog.treatment_note: This is a hypothetical customer responsibility, not a HarborPay vendor control failure. The mock v2 does not configure a real system.
